name: Daily Status Briefing
description: Workflow version of status_recap - gets weather, crypto, stocks, alerts, reminders, system health and creates canvas report

steps.description: Get current reminders needing attention and what's coming up next

steps.llm_prompt:
Create a clean, well-formatted status report using this data. Use plain markdown only.

Date: ${date} (${day_of_week})
Time: ${timestamp}

## Weather (${location}):
- Temperature: ${temperature}°F (feels like ${feels_like}°F)
- Condition: ${condition}
- Humidity: ${humidity}%
- Wind: ${wind_speed} mph

## Crypto:
- Bitcoin: $${btc_price} (${btc_change}% 24h)
- Solana: $${sol_price} (${sol_change}% 24h)
- Bitcoin chart: ${btc_chart_range} with ${btc_chart_points} points
- Solana chart: ${sol_chart_range} with ${sol_chart_points} points

## Stocks:
- TSLA: $${tsla_price} (${tsla_change}% today)
- Gold: $${gold_price} (${gold_change}% today)

## Alerts: ${alert_count} pending
${alerts}

## Current Reminders: ${reminder_count}
${reminders_markdown}

CRITICAL REMINDER RULES:
- The reminder block above is source-of-truth and already formatted.
- Reproduce EVERY reminder entry from that block.
- Do NOT omit any reminder that appears in the provided block.
- Do NOT summarize the reminder list into fewer items.
- Do NOT add notes like 'incomplete', 'additional reminders', 'monitored for updates', or any similar commentary.
- Do NOT invent missing fields or speculate.
- Preserve the triggered vs scheduled grouping exactly.
- Preserve reminder IDs, titles, spoken state, trigger times, acknowledged state, and recurrence when present.

## System Health:
- CPU: ${cpu_percent}%
- RAM: ${memory_percent}% (${memory_used_gb}/${memory_total_gb} GB)
- Uptime: ${uptime}

Format nicely with emojis for sections (🌤️ Weather, 📈 Crypto, 📊 Stocks, 🚨 Alerts, ⏰ Reminders, 💻 System). Add green/red indicators for price changes.

In the crypto section, create two clearly separated subsections so the charts do not appear stacked without context:
1. **Bitcoin ${btc_chart_range} Chart**
   - One short sentence on the trend
   - Then this exact chart block:
```crypto-chart
{"title":"Bitcoin ${btc_chart_range} Chart","endpoint":"/api/prices/crypto/${btc_coin_id}/chart?days=7&points_limit=120"}
```
2. **Solana ${sol_chart_range} Chart**
   - One short sentence on the trend
   - Then this exact chart block:
```crypto-chart
{"title":"Solana ${sol_chart_range} Chart","endpoint":"/api/prices/crypto/${sol_coin_id}/chart?days=7&points_limit=120"}
```

Keep the headings and sentences outside the fenced chart blocks. Use actual values only; do not output placeholder syntax like ${var}. Keep the overall report concise but complete.

success_speech: Daily status report created. Weather, crypto, stocks, and system health are on your canvas.
